about: Golden vectors for cadagent.formulas.bearings, typed in from the makers' worked examples and tables (not generated by the code). Each names its source and page; tests/formulas/test_bearings.py runs every one. 'rel' is the tolerance against the printed value, set by how the source rounded it.

vectors.source: SKF 17000/1 EN (2018-10), C.3 Centrifugal pump, p. 230: a pair of 7312 BECBP back-to-back, P = 0.57 Fr + 0.93 Fa = 11.52 kN, C = 168.5 kN, 3 000 r/min, L10h = 17 400 h
SKF 17000/1 EN (2018-10), C.1 Vibrating screen, p. 217: 22328 CCJA/W33VA405, C = 1 357 kN, P = 186 kN, p = 10/3, 756 r/min, aSKF 1.3, L10mh = 21 500 h (computed there with C/P rounded to 7.3)
SKF 17000/1 EN (2018-10), Table 3, p. 90 (in accordance with ISO 281)
SKF 17000/1 EN (2018-10), Table 9, p. 257, normal clearance, rows f0 Fa/C0 = 0.172, 1.03 and 6.89
SKF 17000/1 EN (2018-10), Table 9, p. 257, C3 and C4 clearance, row f0 Fa/C0 = 2.07
SKF 17000/1 EN (2018-10), Table 4, p. 91: 1 million revolutions = 180 / (2 gamma) million oscillation cycles
Menck and Stammler, Wind Energy Science 9 (2024), Section 2.1.1, p. 780: theta = 10 degrees, L10,rev = 1 million revolutions gives 9 million oscillations

SKF 17000/1 EN (2018-10), Static load rating, p. 104: C0 gives 4 200 MPa at the most loaded contact of a ball bearing (ISO 76). A cross-check of the Hertz model, not a worked example: ISO 76's own C0 = f0 Z Dw^2 for 7 balls of 5.953 mm with the 6201's f0 = 12, Stribeck's Qmax = 5 Fr / Z and the inner groove radius ISO 76 assumes, 0.52 Dw

nsk_contact.source: NSK Technical Report E728h, Section 5.4, p. 117, Example: a 6210 under Fr = 3 500 N: Pmax = 2 170 MPa, 2a = 3.92 mm, 2b = 0.39 mm (K1 143, K2 0.258, K3 0.026 from Table 1)
